description: This Java source file defines the ConditionalHeadersValidator class, which checks HTTP conditional headers in commands based on entity tags (ETags). It enforces validation logic and throws exceptions for precondition failures or not-modified responses.

classes.name: ConditionalHeadersValidator
classes.description: A final class responsible for validating HTTP conditional headers against entity tags, configurable via ValidationSettings, throwing runtime exceptions on validation failure.

classes.name: ConditionalHeadersValidator.ValidationSettings
classes.description: An interface to provide methods creating exceptions for different validation outcomes, such as precondition failed or not modified.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory methods to create instances of ConditionalHeadersValidator with specified validation settings and optional predicate to skip precondition checks.

methods.name: checkConditionalHeaders
methods.description: Main method to validate the conditional headers within a command against the current entity tag, throwing exceptions if conditions are not met.

methods.name: skipPreconditionHeaderCheck
methods.description: Determines whether to skip validation based on command category, current entity tag, and an additional predicate.

methods.name: checkIfMatch
methods.description: Validates the 'If-Match' header condition against the current entity tag.

methods.name: checkIfNoneMatch
methods.description: Validates the 'If-None-Match' header condition against the current entity tag.

methods.name: buildPreconditionFailedException
methods.description: Constructs an exception for failed preconditions, adding headers if applicable.

methods.name: buildNotModifiedException
methods.description: Constructs an exception indicating the resource was not modified based on 'If-None-Match' header.

methods.name: appendETagIfNotNull
methods.description: Adds an ETag header to the headers if the provided entity tag is not null.
